fq-note.text: Humminbird XM 9 20 MSI T + Humminbird XM 9 HW MSI T. Side and Down Imaging angles and ranges are from Humminbird's help article on Side Imaging transducers, measured where the echo is 10 dB below the center. 2D is DualBeam Plus; the 60° (83 kHz) and 20° (200 kHz) are from the same help article, also measured at −10 dB. Second transducer, Humminbird XM 9 HW MSI T: Side and Down Imaging angles and ranges are from Humminbird's help article on Side Imaging transducers, measured where the echo is 10 dB below the center. 2D is Dual Spectrum CHIRP (Full 150–220, Narrow 180–240, Wide 140–200 kHz per the product page). The Wide and Narrow angles are from the same help article, which gives them for Dual Spectrum CHIRP at −10 dB but doesn't say they are the 2D cone angles. Only the frequencies the second transducer adds are listed for it. Widths and edge errors are at your depth.
